angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 518,992 km at 42.59 pc = 0.16 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 23.4804 +/- 0.0142 mas (same row, RUWE 0.96): 42.59 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.746 +/- 0.0206 solar radii from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1807 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract): 518,992 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.8048 +/- 0.0231 solar masses from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-1807 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4914 +/- 60 K from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1807 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1807 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-1807.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.598, rounded to two decimals
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, BD+39 2643: main object type MS*, Main Sequence Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1807 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.044 dex, from MacDougall et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1807 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.53313, from MacDougall et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1807 (pscomppars): age 2.1 Gyr, from MacDougall et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1807 (pscomppars): rotation period 8.8 d, from Nardiello et al. 2022 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...664A.163N/abstract)

spinInclinationSource: Computed here from this record's rotation period, projected rotation speed and radius (0.746 solar radii): sin i = v sin i × P / (2πR) = 0.979. Not a measurement of the axis: the three numbers come from different papers.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
